description: Grants reach Codex as per-thread config overrides, never as writes to its config files. The session's MCP servers (docs, linear: defined in the launch config) get their rules: allow tool -> tools.<tool>.approval_mode approve; allow * -> default_tools_approval_mode approve; deny tool -> disabled_tools; deny * -> enabled false. A server Codex would load on its own (github, from config/read) is switched off, so its grant does not apply; a rule for a server the session does not have (slack) is left out. Command and network grants are never passed to Codex (it has no per-invocation rule for them): Switchyard answers its requests. Synthesised from the codex app-server JSON schema generated by codex-cli 0.144.1 (`codex app-server generate-json-schema`), not captured from a live run: replace with a capture (see crates/codex-adapter/README.md).
